items.title: Humana (HUM) Beats On Earnings And Quality, Is The Stock Above Fair Value?
items.summary: Humana (HUM) is back on investors’ radar after a strong earnings beat, fresh quality gains in its insurance operations, new caregiver retention initiatives in Indiana, and a leadership hire to oversee its Medicaid unit. See our latest analysis for Humana. Humana’s recent earnings beat and operational gains have come alongside strong price momentum, with a 27.5% 90 day share price return and 47.1% year to date share price return, although the 3 year total shareholder return is still down...

items.title: Humana, UnitedHealth trim Medicare Advantage on rising costs
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Columnist Kerry Hannon explains that major health insurers like Humana (HUM) and UnitedHealth Group (UNH) are dropping hundreds of thousands of Medicare Advantage members to protect profit margins as rising utilization drives up costs.

items.title: Humana Is Dropping Plans That Cover 600,000 Medicare Members in 2027. The Letters Arrive in September.
items.summary: A Humana termination letter looks like bad news, but it quietly unlocks a set of rights most members never knew they had, and those rights expire on a clock most people never see coming.
